COMPOSITION
The markdown has 8 logical sections (including intro) against 7 template slots, so one reuse is needed; the dense "Un son d'exception" section (268 words, 2 H3 groups) will be split across slots [1] and [2] to fill the two consecutive content-image slots naturally. Specialized slots are well-matched: [3] stats fits "Caractéristiques techniques" perfectly, [5] testimonial fits "Ce que disent les experts" exactly, and [6] hero closes with "FAQ" as a compact CTA-style ending. The remaining sections ("Connectivité avancée," "Application mobile," "Prix et disponibilité") distribute across the mid-page slots [4] and reused content-image, preserving the dark → dark → dark → neutral → light → neutral visual rhythm of the template.
